Name: Farm Renovator
Author: K1riko87
Description:
[size=4][b]中文详细介绍[/b]
农场装修让你在专门的编辑页面中调整农场和自家农舍的布局。移动当场生效，可以随时撤销；结束装修时，也可以选择保留本次布局或放弃全部修改。
支持搬动建筑、机器、箱子、火把、围栏、铺路地板，以及床、电视、鱼缸、梳妆台等原版家具。普通树、果树、普通作物、巨型作物和部分自然障碍物也能重新安排位置。箱内物品、机器生产进度、树上果实、采集器及花盆中的植物会随原物体保留。
侧栏按同类物体合并显示图标、名称和数量，果树与作物显示具体品种。同种果树不会因为挂果数量不同而分开，每棵树仍保留自己的果实。列表支持连续滚动和拖动滚动条。
使用流程：[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]在单人游戏的农场或自家农舍按 [b]F6[/b]，或者打开游戏菜单，点击 [b]「装修」[/b][/color]。[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]左键点击物体，再点击目标位置，即可移动。多格物体可以从任意占地格选中；再次点击原位即可放下。[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]按住右键拖动地图，手中的物体会保持选中。鼠标放在地图上滚动可缩放，放在侧栏上滚动可浏览列表。[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]没有选中待放置物体时，按住左键拖出选区，使用拿起、删除自然物或收起物品。[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]批量布置时，先把物体拿起到「待摆放」，选中对应分组，再选择逐个、框选或涂放模式。[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]点击「退出」，选择保存本次布局、放弃修改或继续装修。[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]按钮与选项：[/size]
[table][tr][th][size=4]按钮／选项[/size][/th]
[th][size=4]用途[/size][/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]撤销[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]撤销本次装修中的上一项操作。批量拿起、框选放置或一次连续涂放，可整批撤销。快捷键为 [b]Ctrl+Z[/b]。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]网格[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]显示或隐藏地图格线，帮助对齐建筑和物品。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]全部拿起[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]将当前地点所有受支持的可移动物体暂放到「待摆放」列表，方便重新布局。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]退出[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]结束装修。有修改时打开退出确认窗口。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]已有物体／待摆放[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]点击侧栏顶部切换列表。「已有物体」显示当前地点的玩家设施、作物及可确认来源的植物；「待摆放」显示临时拿起的物体。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]放置：逐个[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]一次点击放置一个物体，关闭框选和涂放。放置后若仍有同类待摆放物体，可继续放置。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]放置：框选[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]选中待摆放物体后，按住左键拖出范围。绿色表示可以放置；数量不足或位置冲突时显示红色，整批不执行。多格物体和树木会按占地、间隔安排位置。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]放置：涂放[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]选中待摆放物体后，按住左键沿途放置。重复经过已放置格子不会重复消耗物体，无效位置会跳过，数量用完即停止。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]清除全部自然物[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]清理当前地点受支持的自然物，包括已经拿起的自然物。可以撤销。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]拿起[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]框选后出现。将选区内可移动物体转入「待摆放」，暂不收入背包。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]删除自然物[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]框选后出现。清理选区内的野草、杂草、石头、树枝、自然树及其树苗树种、远古斑点等，不产生采集掉落。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]收起物品[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]框选后出现。将支持的机器、箱子和家具标记为收入背包，保存并退出时完成收纳。保留独立状态的物品分别占用背包空位。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]放弃修改[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]撤回本次装修的全部修改，恢复打开装修时的布局并退出。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]保存并退出[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]保留当前布局并处理待收纳物品。未摆放物体或背包空间不足时会提示处理；存档仍由游戏正常睡觉保存。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]继续装修[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]关闭退出确认窗口，回到编辑页面。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][size=4]三种放置模式只能开启一种，选择会被记住。[b]框选放置与范围选择的区别取决于手中是否有待摆放物体[/b]：手中有物体时用于铺放，没有物体时用于圈选已有物体。
摆放规则会检查地图边界、占地冲突、树木间隔和出入口。作物移栽后，原位置恢复普通土地，目标位置自动形成耕地，并保留作物与原土壤状态。其他物体放到没有作物的耕地上时，会先恢复普通土地；已有作物不会被直接覆盖。床需要满足房屋等级和床边通行要求，蟹笼需要合适水域。
自然物清理不会产生资源掉落。没有种植标记、施肥或采集器的普通树会被视为自然物，旧存档中未记录来源的树也适用这一规则。有上述标记的树和玩家设施会受到保护。
其他操作：[/size]
[table][tr][th][size=4]输入[/size][/th]
[th][size=4]操作[/size][/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]WASD／方向键[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]移动选格与视野。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]＋／－[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]放大或缩小地图。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]M[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]切换放置模式。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Delete[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]清除全部自然物。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Page Up／Page Down[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]滚动侧栏列表。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Tab／Enter[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]切换并执行底部按钮。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Esc[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]打开退出确认；确认窗口中再次按下可返回。[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][size=4]手柄支持：[b]左肩键＋按下右摇杆[/b]打开装修；十字键移动选格，[b]A[/b]选取、放置或确认，[b]B[/b]取消选择；肩键切换底部按钮，扳机滚动列表，[b]Y[/b]选取当前可见列表首项，[b]X[/b]切换列表，[b]Start[/b]退出。按下右摇杆切换放置模式，按下左摇杆清除全部自然物。拖动框选与涂放使用鼠标完成。
当前适用于单人农场与自家农舍。固定地图设施、冰箱、施工中的建筑及正在使用的家具受到限制。当前不提供家具目录、任意背包物品直接取用、独立范围开垦或联机装修；第三方自定义物体需要专门适配。[/size]
[line]
[size=4][b]English Description[/b]
Farm Renovator provides a dedicated editor for rearranging your farm and farmhouse. Moves take effect immediately, with undo available throughout the session. When you finish, you can keep the layout or discard all changes made during that session.
Move supported buildings, machines, chests, torches, fences, flooring and native furniture, including beds, TVs, fish tanks and dressers. Trees, fruit trees, regular crops, giant crops and supported natural obstacles can also be relocated. Objects retain their contents and state, including chest inventories, machine progress, fruit, attached tappers and potted plants.
The sidebar groups matching objects into counted entries with icons and names. Fruit trees and crops display their species. Different fruit counts do not split matching trees into separate groups, and each tree retains its own fruit. Lists scroll continuously and include a draggable scrollbar.
Getting started:[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]Press [b]F6[/b] on your farm or in your farmhouse in single-player, or select [b]Renovate[/b] from the game menu.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Left-click an object, then click its destination. Any occupied tile selects the whole object. Click it in place again to put it down.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Hold the right mouse button and drag to pan without losing your selection. Scroll over the map to zoom or over the sidebar to browse.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]With no object selected, left-drag an area to reveal lifting, debris-clearing and collection actions.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]For bulk placement, lift objects into [b]Staged[/b], select a group, then choose single, area or paint placement.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Select [b]Exit[/b] to keep your layout, discard the session or continue editing.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]Buttons and options:[/size]
[table][tr][th][size=4]Button / option[/size][/th]
[th][size=4]Function[/size][/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Undo[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Reverses the previous operation in the current session. Bulk lifting, area placement and an entire paint stroke can each be undone together. Shortcut: [b]Ctrl+Z[/b].[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Grid[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Shows or hides tile lines to help align objects and buildings.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Lift all[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Temporarily moves every supported movable object in the current location into the Staged list.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Exit[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Leaves the editor. If changes exist, opens the exit confirmation.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]On location / Staged[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Switches sidebar lists. On location shows player equipment, crops and plants with recognized ownership. Staged contains temporarily lifted objects.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Place: single[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Places one object per click, with area and paint placement disabled. Matching staged objects remain available for continued placement.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Place: area[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Select a staged group, then left-drag a rectangle. Green indicates a valid batch. Insufficient stock or a placement conflict turns it red and leaves the entire batch untouched. Placement accounts for footprints and tree spacing.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Place: paint[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Select staged objects, then hold the left button while moving across tiles. Already painted tiles are not charged again, invalid positions are skipped, and placement stops when stock runs out.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Clear all debris[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Removes supported natural objects throughout the current location, including staged debris. Can be undone.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Lift[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Appears after area selection. Transfers movable objects in the selection to Staged without collecting them into your backpack.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Clear debris[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Appears after area selection. Removes natural grass, weeds, stones, twigs, wild trees, saplings, tree seeds, artifact spots and similar supported debris without harvest drops.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Collect[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Appears after area selection. Marks supported machines, chests and furniture for your backpack when you save and exit. Objects with preserved individual state require separate inventory slots.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Discard changes[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Restores the layout from the start of the editing session and exits.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Save and exit[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Keeps the layout and collects marked items. Unplaced objects or insufficient inventory space must be resolved first. The game still writes your save normally when you sleep.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Keep editing[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Closes the confirmation and returns to the editor.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][size=4]Only one placement mode can be active, and your choice is remembered. [b]Left-dragging places an area when you are holding staged objects; with nothing selected, it selects existing objects instead.[/b]
Placement checks include map boundaries, occupancy, tree spacing and access routes. Moving crops restores bare ground at the source and tills the destination while retaining the crop and its soil state. Placing other objects on empty tilled soil restores bare ground first; existing crops remain protected. Beds require a suitable house upgrade and bedside access, while crab pots require suitable water.
Debris clearing does not generate resource drops. Ordinary trees without a planting marker, fertilizer or tapper count as natural objects, including older trees whose planting history was never recorded. Trees with those markers and player equipment are protected.
Additional controls:[/size]
[table][tr][th][size=4]Input[/size][/th]
[th][size=4]Action[/size][/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]WASD / arrow keys[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Move the tile cursor and view.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]＋ / −[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Zoom in or out.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]M[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Cycle placement modes.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Delete[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Clear all debris.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Page Up / Page Down[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Scroll the sidebar.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Tab / Enter[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Select and activate footer buttons.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][size=4][b]Esc[/b][/size][/td]
[td][size=4]Open the exit confirmation, or close it when already open.[/size][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][size=4]Controller support: press [b]left shoulder + right-stick click[/b] to open the editor. Use the D-pad to move the cursor, [b]A[/b] to select, place or confirm, and [b]B[/b] to cancel selection. Shoulders select footer buttons, triggers scroll the list, [b]Y[/b] selects the first visible entry, [b]X[/b] switches lists and [b]Start[/b] exits. Click the right stick to cycle placement modes or the left stick to clear all debris. Drag selection and paint placement use the mouse.
Currently supports single-player farms and the player’s farmhouse. Fixed map features, fridges, buildings under construction and occupied furniture remain restricted. Furniture catalogues, general inventory placement, a separate area-tilling tool and multiplayer editing are not included. Third-party custom objects require dedicated compatibility support.[/size]
